name: Shading Replacement for Relighting
aliases: Shading Replacement for Relighting — Normal-Based Shading Transfer
definition: A method to generate object shading under scene illumination by replacing object point shading with shading from nearby scene points sharing similar normal vectors.
summary: Shading Replacement for Relighting avoids inferring scene illumination by replacing an object's shading with values from existing scene points, setting it apart by not requiring explicit light source estimation.
